implementation: native C++ retained-click sampler with Gaussian zero updates

vacuum_kernel_options.product: reciprocal diagonal product; logarithmic fallback on a nonnormal intermediate product
vacuum_kernel_options.sampling_guards: unchanged; no fast-math and no score-floor policy change

sample_log_probabilities.meaning: natural log of actual computed conditional chain under ideal continuous uniforms
sample_log_probabilities.accumulation: long double log(p_one) or log1p(-p_one), double output
sample_log_probabilities.timing: allocation and evaluation included in sampling

prefix_cache.key: complete fixed-order measured prefix; trie local to this batch
prefix_cache.value: successful computed conditional, retained clicks, and child indices
prefix_cache.state: lazy reconstruction on first miss; replay every prior zero in original order
prefix_cache.law: unchanged computed conditional chain; no target-law access or smoothing
prefix_cache.timing: allocation, insertion, lookup and reconstruction included in sampling

pairwise_score_policy.structural_zero: exact zero original 2x2 covariance crossblock gives MI=0
pairwise_score_policy.precision: explicit long-double scalar 2x2 factors and whitening
